origin: Largest first failure (winner outside W: 48 of 113 formal races; 25 of those winners were market top-3). ChatGPT 11/20: drive one improvement through fix -> forward test -> decision -> post-adoption tracking, with SAME budget. Owner 2026-11-20 09:46「どうしますか？」.
extends: R1-R8 unchanged; C18/C19 (exacta part only) stay as they are
change_under_test: W' = W + the two shortest-odds horses at the latest pre-start PAPER revision. The added heads get 60 x added/|W'| points (三連単 head->P2->best-2 thirds after 3 馬単 head->P2), replacing the LAST delivered formal tickets. Total stays 60 points / 6,000 yen. The added share is capped by the combinations available; unused share stays delivered tickets.
learning_races: 2026-11-16..19 formal 113R (in-sample: designed after seeing these races)
venue_rule: same direction in >= 2 venues with >= 12 races each; no venue with >= 12 races clearly worse (> 10 points)

candidates.hypothesis: With the same 60 points, giving the two market favourites a W share raises PFS excluding the top-1 race and the number of hit races versus the delivered formal tickets.
candidates.primary_metric: PFS excluding the top-1 race (paired by race), hit races, hit-but-loss races, per venue
candidates.promote_if: at 100 races: PFS excluding top-1 higher than R54_60 AND hit races higher AND the venue rule holds -> decision packet to the Owner; if adopted, track the same metrics for the next 100 races after adoption (post-adoption check) and revert if PFS excluding top-1 falls below R54_60 replay
candidates.reject_if: at 100 races PFS excluding top-1 is not higher than R54_60, or the venue rule fails
